schema:name: Interview with Yosuke Honjo
schema:description:
Yosuke Jay O. Honjo serves as President and CEO of ITO EN North America, Inc., which he founded in 2001. His father, Masanori Honjo (1934-2002) – a former Nissan car salesman – founded ITO EN in Japan as a tea leaf wholesale distribution business in 1966. Using innovative business methods for its time, such as direct sales to supermarkets and television commercial advertising, ITO EN quickly became the largest tea distributor and manufacturer in Japan. In 1989, the global beverage company brought to market the world’s first bottled unsweetened green tea, Oi Ocha. Since then, ITO EN has continued its commitment to health, wellness, and sustainability through its diversified product line that includes black oolong tea, coffee, vegetable juices, mineral water, and vitamins. Its subsidiaries include Distant Lands Coffee, a vertically-integrated specialty roasting and distribution company that sources directly from socially-conscious coffee farms through its green coffee trading division, La Minita.

Yosuke Honjo earned his BA in Commerce from Waseda University in Tokyo and an MBA from the USC Marshall School of Business. He serves on numerous advisory boards including the Honjo International Scholarship Foundation, the Nippon Club in New York, the U.S.-Japan Council, the Metropolitan Museum of Art Advisory Committee on Cultural Engagement, and the Columbia University School of Social Work. He is the recipient of the USC Asian Pacific Alumni Association Leadership Award.
